title: Con Dao in 3 days
summary: Ho Chi Minh City to Con Dao. The prison camps, Hang Duong, and the national park. Turtle nights sit on the turtle-watch interest.

days.title: Day 1 — Fly in
days.body: Fly from Ho Chi Minh City.

days.title: Day 2 — The camps
days.body: The prison is a morning or an afternoon. Hang Duong is a stop after the camps. Fees are Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 3 — The park
days.body: A day on the water or in the forest. The scenic fee is 60,000 or 50,000 VND by route.
